seal.condition_sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM skeleton.skeleton_ledger_entryline l WHERE l.entry_id = NEW.sysid AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) >= 2 AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0) FROM skeleton.skeleton_ledger_entryline l WHERE l.entry_id = NEW.sysid AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) = NEW.total AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0) FROM skeleton.skeleton_ledger_entryline l WHERE l.entry_id = NEW.sysid AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) = NEW.total AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skeleton.skeleton_ledger_entryline l JOIN skeleton.skeleton_ledger_account a ON a.sysid = l.account_id WHERE l.entry_id = NEW.sysid AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND (a.book_id <> NEW.book_id OR a.is_group OR NOT a.is_active OR a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR l.date <> NEW.date)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skeleton.skeleton_ledger_book b WHERE b.sysid = NEW.book_id AND b.locked_until IS NOT NULL AND NEW.date <= b.locked_until)
